sign_up_offers.title: SingSaver Card + Banking Bundle Offer
sign_up_offers.terms:
This promotion runs from 9 September 2026 to 30 September 2026.
Eligible applicants must not hold an existing Citi credit card, or have closed one within the past 12 months from card account opening date.
To qualify for the S$500 Cash reward, applicants must:
Apply for a participating Citi credit card via SingSaver;
Make a minimum spend of S$500 within 30 days of card approval; and
Hold a valid Citi banking account (existing or newly opened) by the end of the month following card approval.
The S$500 Cash reward replaces the standard SingSaver exclusive reward for your card—you receive one or the other, not the both. The S$500 Cash amount is the same regardless of which card you apply for.

extra.tag: Best for unlimited miles with broad airline transfer options
extra.description:
The Citi PremierMiles Card stands out as a premier choice for frequent flyers, offering exclusive benefits like Priority Pass airport lounge access, comprehensive travel insurance coverage, Citi Miles that never expire, and enticing online travel booking promotions. Moreover, its inclusion of Citi-wide lifestyle and dining promotions, coupled with a reasonable minimum income requirement, positions it as an excellent entry-level air miles card, appealing to a wide range of potential users.
Citi PremierMiles cardholders earn 1.2 miles per S$1 spent on local spending and 2.2 miles per S$1 spent on foreign currency spending, enabling you to accumulate miles quickly. Arguably, one of the best parts of the Citi PremierMiles Card is that its Citi Miles, which you can convert to a wide range of frequent flyer programmes like KrisFlyer, never expire – offering unparalleled convenience and redemption flexibility.
Moreover, Citibank will gift you with a renewal bonus of 10,000 Citi Miles upon your card anniversary. On top of all that, cardholders enjoy additional luxuries of Priority Pass airport lounge access at selected airports – with the Principal Cardholder being entitled to 2 complimentary visits per calendar year at participating airport lounges worldwide.
